notes.title: JUMP DLC RELEASE
notes.notes:
[b]HOW BEAUTIFUL, FINALLY![/b]
JUMP DLC IS FINALLY READY AND CAN BE ACCESSED FROM 02/26/2025!!
It can be accessed through the game's main menu or by interacting with the cave, in WaterVille!
It has puzzles, bossfights and much more!
I hope you like it!
It was made with lots of care and love!
Ass: Coronho!
